title: Franca course node (course/<name>.node.yaml)
description: A level, stage, unit or domain module in the course tree. Lessons are written in lesson files (lesson.schema.json). Imported into catalogue_course_node_v, catalogue_module_v, catalogue_node_can_do_v and catalogue_goal_link_v.

parent.description: The node this one belongs to. A level has none.

position.description: The node's place among the children of its parent, from 0.

can_dos.description: The can-do descriptors the node works towards.

module.description: For a domain module: terminology is offered from the first level, and genre and task work from the second.
